## Features
- Stunning 1000 LED Premier TreeBright lights
- Clear cable with warm white lights
- With a memory chip to ensure functions remembered
- Comes with a 3 pin UK plug
- Has a 5m lead length plug to bulb
- A total of 25m lit length
- LEDs are spaced 2.5cm apart

## Information
Make this Christmas truly magical with these exquisite decorative cluster lights, perfect for illuminating both indoor and outdoor displays. With 100 warm white LEDs stretching over 25 meters of lit length and a generous 5-meter lead from the plug to the first bulb, you'll have no trouble finding a convenient spot near a socket. Operated by mains with a low voltage UK 3-pin transformer, these lights prioritize safety and must remain dry at all times. ## Features
- 8 Lighting Modes With Memory Function
- Low Power Consumption and Long Lasting LED Bulbs
- Dark Green Cable
- IP44 Waterproof, Indoor & Outdoor Use
- Low Voltage For Protection, Safe To Touch
- 8 lighting modes with memory function for consistent effects after power cycles.
- Low power consumption, long-lasting LED bulbs to save energy and reduce replacements.
- Dark green cable for discreet installation and classic festive look.
- IP44 waterproof adapter and cable rating, suitable for indoor and outdoor display.
- Low-voltage design and cool-to-touch LEDs for enhanced safety.
- Built-in 8-hour timer (8 hours on, 16 hours off) for automatic daily operation.
- Includes Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential, and Twinkle/Flash modes.
- 720 LEDs with 1.25cm bulb spacing for full festive coverage.
- 5m lead wire with mains UK plug and 31V low-voltage adapter for safer outdoor use.
- Multi-colour LED cluster lights featuring 720 bulbs for dense, vibrant illumination.

## Information
NETTA mains-powered cluster string lights are suitable for indoor and outdoor use and provide a bright decorative lighting effect for Christmas and other occasions. Featuring warm white and cool white lighting, multiple lighting modes with memory function and a convenient automatic timer, these lights are easy to install and operate. The dark green cable blends naturally with Christmas trees and outdoor greenery, making the lights ideal for Christmas displays, parties, weddings, gardens and other seasonal decorations.
CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Let your tree shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Multi-Coloured Christmas Cluster Lights that feature 720 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for weddings, birthday parties and events. 8 HOURS ON TIMER SETTING: The timer function allows your lights to turn automatically when it gets dark. To activate the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns green. You will then be able to select your preferred lighting mode and the lights will remain on for 8 hours and turn off for 16 automatically. To turn off the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns white. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. The bulbs are set 1.25cm apart to ensure that you get a full festive glow over this Christmas period. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. A 5M lead wire ensures easy installation of these lights.

- 8 lighting modes with memory function for easy, repeatable effects.
- Low power consumption and long-lasting LED bulbs for extended use.
- Dark green cable for discreet installation and neat appearance.
- IP44 waterproof adapter and cable, suitable for indoor and outdoor use.
- Low voltage design for added safety, safe to touch and energy efficient.
- 8-hour timer (8h on / 16h off) for automatic daily operation.
- Modes include Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential, Twinkle/Flash.
- 480 LEDs with 1.25cm bulb spacing for a dense festive glow.
- 5m lead wire with low-voltage 31V adapter and UK mains plug for safe installation.
- Multi-colour cluster lights with 480 LEDs for vibrant festive lighting.

## Information
NETTA mains-powered cluster string lights are suitable for indoor and outdoor use and provide a bright decorative lighting effect for Christmas and other occasions. Featuring warm white and cool white lighting, multiple lighting modes with memory function and a convenient automatic timer, these lights are easy to install and operate. The dark green cable blends naturally with Christmas trees and outdoor greenery, making the lights ideal for Christmas displays, parties, weddings, gardens and other seasonal decorations.
CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Let your tree shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Multi-Coloured Christmas Cluster Lights that feature with 480 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for weddings, birthday parties and events. 8 HOURS ON TIMER SETTING: The timer function allows your lights to turn automatically when it gets dark. To activate the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns green. You will then be able to select your preferred lighting mode and the lights will remain on for 8 hours and turn off for 16 automatically. To turn off the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns white. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. The bulbs are set 1.25cm apart to ensure that you get a full festive glow over this Christmas period. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. A 5M lead wire ensures easy installation of these lights.

## Information
1000 LED Premier TreeBrights Indoor Outdoor Christmas Multi-Function Mains Operated String Lights with Timer Clear Cable in Multicoloured. Brighten up your home this Christmas with these mains-operated multi-function TreeBrights on a clear cable by Premier Decorations. Specifically designed for Christmas trees, LEDs are spaced approximately 2.5cm apart, giving three times as many bulbs per metre than regular lights. Switch through the 8 available functions with the press of a dual-purpose button on the transformer. The button can be held in to activate and deactivate the 8 hours on 16 hours off timer function, timer is active when the button is illuminated. This set contains a built-in memory chip which allows the previous setting to be remembered. Available functions static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing-flash, slow fade and twinkleflash. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, with an IP20-rated transformer that must be kept dry at all times.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 750 LEDs in Cool White
- Specifically designed for Christmas trees
- Mains operated with a 5m lead
- Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use
- Transformer that must be kept dry at all times
- 8 available functions
- Contains a built-in memory chip
- ECO-friendly non-replaceable bulbs

## Information
Transform your home into a mesmerizing winter wonderland with these String Lights. This stunning set of string lights spans 18.7 meters in length, creating a magical ambience that captures the essence of the holiday season. Specifically designed for Christmas trees, LEDs are spaced approximately 2.5cm apart on a green wire, giving three times as many bulbs per metre than regular lights. Easy to place with a 5m lead length from the UK 3-pin transformer to the first bulb. Switch through the 8 available functions with the press of a dual-purpose button on the transformer. The button can be held in to activate and deactivate the 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer function, the timer is active when the button is illuminated. This set contains a built-in memory chip which allows the previous setting to be remembered. Available functions: static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade and twinkle/flash. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, with an IP-20 rated transformer that must be kept dry at all times. ECO-friendly non-replaceable bulbs - save up to 90% on energy costs. Not just for Christmas, this set can be used at any point of the year and in a variety of ways, ideal for providing ambient lighting and creating eye-catching scenes.

## Information
NETTA mains-powered cluster string lights are suitable for indoor and outdoor use and provide a bright decorative lighting effect for Christmas and other occasions. Featuring warm white and cool white lighting, multiple lighting modes with memory function and a convenient automatic timer, these lights are easy to install and operate. The dark green cable blends naturally with Christmas trees and outdoor greenery, making the lights ideal for Christmas displays, parties, weddings, gardens and other seasonal decorations.
CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Let your tree shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Cool White Christmas Cluster Lights that feature 480 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for parties and events. 8 HOURS ON TIMER SETTING: The timer function allows your lights to turn automatically when it gets dark. To activate the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns green. You will then be able to select your preferred lighting mode and the lights will remain on for 8 hours and turn off for 16 automatically. To turn off the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns white. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. Add a warm, festive glow with NETTA 5m LED warm white fairy string lights, ideal for Christmas, weddings, parties and outdoor décor. Features a mains UK plug with low-voltage IP44 adapter for safe indoor and outdoor use, and a 5m lead for easy installation. Choose from 8 lighting modes with memory—Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash—using the control button on the plug. CHRISTMAS FAIRY LIGHTS: Let your home shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Multi-Coloured Christmas Fairy Lights that feature 500 beaming bulbs. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. Just plug in and switch on to add a warm, festive glow to any room or area. ## Information
Add a warm, festive glow with NETTA 5m LED warm white fairy string lights, ideal for Christmas, weddings, parties and outdoor décor. Features a mains UK plug with low-voltage IP44 adapter for safe indoor and outdoor use, and a 5m lead for easy installation. Choose from 8 lighting modes with memory—Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash—using the control button on the plug. Built-in timer lets lights run 8 hours on and 16 hours off (hold power button 3 seconds to enable or disable). Bulbs are spaced 5 cm apart for consistent coverage. Includes a 365-day warranty and manufacturer support from NETTA.
CHRISTMAS FAIRY LIGHTS: Let your home shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Multi-Coloured Christmas Fairy Lights that feature 300 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for parties and events. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. The bulbs are set 5cm apart to ensure that you get a full festive glow over this Christmas period. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. A 5M lead wire ensures easy installation of these lights. EASY TO USE: No batteries are required for this product making them super-easy to use. Just plug in and switch on to add a warm, festive glow to any room or area. They are safe to touch whilst they are on and have a 30M lit length to save you from struggling whilst creating your seasonal scene. 365-DAY WARRANTY: We hope that you love these lights, but on the off-chance that you don't, NETTA provides a full 365-day warranty on this product. If you are not completely satisfied with this item, please don't hesitate to contact our customer service department.

## Features
- 37 LEDs per metre for bright cool white light
- Flexible 13mm PVC tube bends with ease
- Complete wiring kit for easy installation

## Information
Transform your home, garden, or event space with this professional-grade 13mm LED rope light, offering ultra-bright cool white illumination with 36 high-intensity LEDs per metre. Encased in flexible, durable PVC tubing, it bends easily around curves, corners, and complex shapes, making it ideal for decorative, architectural, or outdoor lighting projects. Perfect for patios, pathways, signage, party decorations, and garden outlines, this versatile rope light ensures vibrant, uniform lighting wherever it is installed. The kit includes all necessary wiring accessories, including a 2-metre live end power cable, end cap, inline splice, power connector, and heat shrink, enabling quick, safe, and secure setup. Built to withstand temperatures from -20°C to +60°C, it is weather-resistant and suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The rope light is clearly marked at 1-metre intervals for safe cutting and precise custom lengths, allowing professional-level installations with ease. Durable, flexible, and reliable, this LED rope light combines functionality and style for a wide range of creative lighting applications.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 25 G40 globe bulbs plus 2 spare
- Solar or USB charging
- Auto on at dusk
- 8 to 10 hours of light
- 4 lighting modes
- 4400mAh battery
- IP64 weather resistant
- No wiring needed

## Information
Add a warm bistro glow to your garden with no cables or plug sockets. These 7.6m solar festoon lights have 25 G40 globe bulbs, plus 2 spares, and switch on automatically at dusk. Charge by solar panel in about 8 hours or by USB in about 4 hours for 8 to 10 hours of light. Four modes, steady, quick flash, slow flash and pulse, suit everything from quiet dinners to parties and weddings. 4400mAh battery, IP64 weather resistant, 30,000 hour life. Top up by USB in winter when the sun is low. 7.6m suits a balcony rail, gazebo or small patio where there is no outdoor socket.

Add a charming warm white glow to your outdoor spaces with this set of 12m 200 LED Solar Powered Garden String Lights. Ideal for decorating trees, shrubs, fences, patios and pergolas, these versatile solar lights combine attractive illumination with hassle-free operation. These lights offer an easy way to create a relaxing atmosphere for outdoor dining, entertaining and everyday garden enjoyment. The set features 200 warm white LEDs positioned along a dark green cable, helping the lights blend naturally into garden foliage, hedges and outdoor displays. The 12m illuminated length provides excellent coverage for decorating pathways, seating areas, gazebos and garden borders. Powered by solar energy, the solar panel charges during daylight hours and automatically switches the lights on at dusk. Once fully charged, the lights remain illuminated for up to 8 hours, allowing you to enjoy beautiful outdoor lighting without the need for mains power or batteries. The string lights offer both static and flashing light functions. Simply use the black switch underneath the solar panel to select your preferred lighting effect. Mains powered and supplied with a 3 metre power cable, it offers flexible placement beside the Christmas tree, on a windowsill, porch, or within a sheltered outdoor display. Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use.

SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. ## Features
- 200 Rainbow LEDs
- Mains-powered lights with 5 metres of lit length
- 8 function multi action controller
- Silver pin wire
- Timer function with 8 hours on and 16 hours off)
- 30cm from the battery pack to the first LED
- Indoor or outdoor use

## Information
Create a stunning Christmas display with these battery-operated multi-function LED lights. With 200 micro LEDs spaced approximately 5cm apart on a delicate silver pin wire, these lights can be easily shaped and arranged to add a touch of magic to any setting. Conveniently switch between 8 functions with the press of a button on the battery pack, including static, in waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and off. The built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer function helps preserve battery life, and a memory chip ensures the lights remember the previous setting. With a 30cm clear lead from the battery pack to the first bulb, you can easily hide it out of sight. The lights are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, featuring a waterproof seal on the battery pack to protect against light splashes. These versatile lights are not just for Christmas: they can enhance any event, from weddings to floral arrangements and interior design, adding a touch of charm and elegance all year round. Illuminate your home with these captivating LED lights and create mesmerizing scenes that will leave a lasting impression on everyone.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Set of 10 acrylic icicle lights (3m lit length)
- 40 LEDs (Choice of White or Warm White)
- Timer function (6 hours On/18 hours Off)
- Outdoor-safe battery pack with 50cm cable
- Requires 4 x AA batteries (not included)

## Information
Add a bright, enchanting glow to your home this Christmas with these Battery Operated Icicle Lights from Christow. Suitable for indoors and outdoors, the string lights contain 10 hanging icicles, beautifully lit by 40 flashing LEDs. With a lit length of 3m, they look fabulous adding a festive glow to rooflines and guttering. Plus, they come in choice of colours to suit your festive theme and create your dream display. 10 x Acrylic LED Icicles Light string contains five large icicles, each containing five LEDs, and five small icicles, each containing three LEDs. The icicles have a clear acrylic construction for a bright, enchanting glow. Plus, a white painted finish on top to create a melting ice effect. Flash Memory Function Love a bit of festive sparkle? Select from 8 light sequences, ranging from twinkly effects to a normal static glow. For convenience, we've also added a memory chip. So, the lights will always remember the last setting selected when turned back on. Timer Function No need to worry about turning the lights on and off each night. Simply turn them on at your desired time when first using them. After that, they'll automatically light up at the same time every night. Plus, they'll automatically turn off after six hours. Outdoor-Safe Battery Pack Powered by 4 x AA batteries with an outdoor-safe IP44-rated battery box. Gives you the freedom to display the lights anywhere, inside or outside your home. Battery box has a 50cm clear cable. So, you can easily hide it behind nearby objects or foliage. What You Need to Know: String of 10 x Acrylic Icicle Lights 5 x small icicles (3 LEDs per icicle) 5 x larger icicles (5 LEDs per icicle Lit Length: 300cm (30cm spacing) 8 flash features (7 effects + static) Timer function (6hrs On/18hrs Off) Outdoor-safe battery pack (IP44-rated) Requires 4 x AA batteries (not included)

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Switch compatible Christmas lights on and off with a simple wave for an interactive festive experience.
- Black and gold magic wand with a warm white LED star tip for an enchanting festive display.
- Control compatible Christmas lights wirelessly from up to 15 metres away.
- Designed to work with most Christmas light sets using compatible 2-pin screw-in round connectors.
- Battery-powered operation requires 2 x AAA batteries, not included; allow 1 to 2 minutes for synchronisation after setup.
- Glowing warm white LED star tip adds a magical touch to Christmas displays.
- Approximately 33 cm long, with a stylish black and gold finish.
- Includes an inline magic control box to connect between the transformer and light set.
- Suitable for compatible 2-pin screw-in round connectors, 5 V to 34 V, maximum 1500 mA.
- Includes a 1-year warranty for added peace of mind.

## Information
Add a touch of enchantment to your festive decorating with the Samuel Alexander Magical Remote Control Wand. Finished in black with elegant gold detailing, it features a glowing warm white LED star tip for an atmospheric Christmas display. Wave the approximately 33 cm wand to switch compatible Christmas lights on or off from up to 15 metres away. The wand works with most Christmas light sets using 2-pin screw-in transformers with round connectors, operating from 5 V to 34 V with a maximum current of 1500 mA. The included inline magic control box connects between the transformer and light set. Allow 1 to 2 minutes for the system to synchronise before use. The wand switches lights on and off only and does not adjust lighting functions. Requires 2 x AAA batteries, not included. For indoor use.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 5.4m warm white multifunction LED garland on flexible silver wire with 6-hour timer.
- Lit length 5.4m with 8m mains cable, ideal for mantels, banisters and trees.
- Contains 860 non-replaceable warm white LEDs, ideal for home and garden lighting.
- Selector button with 3 settings - on/off, multifunction and 6-hour timer.
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use provided the transformer remains dry.
- 860 ultra-bright warm white LEDs mounted on flexible silver wire for easy shaping.
- 8m clear power cable from plug to first light for flexible placement.
- Timer mode runs 6 hours on then 18 hours off for energy efficiency.
- Mains powered with clear 8m cable from plug to first light, transformer must stay dry.
- Dimensions 540cm length, 7cm width, 54cm height.

## Information
Brighten your home this Christmas with a 5.4m warm white LED garland on flexible silver wire. It features 860 ultra-bright non-replaceable LEDs, an 8m clear mains cable and a selector button with on/off, multifunction and a 6-hour timer (6 hours on, 18 hours off) for convenience and energy saving. Suitable for indoor and outdoor displays when the transformer stays dry, ideal for mantels, banisters, trees and outdoor decorations.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Made with durable rubber cables
- Versatile Indoor  Outdoor Use
- Customizable Length

## Information
Manufactured with durable rubber cables, these lights are built to withstand the elements, making them a top choice for all-season use. From warm summer evenings to chilly winter nights, these LED String Lights will keep your outdoor space bright and beautiful year-round. Transform your outdoor setting with these versatile and weather-resistant lights and illuminate any occasion with style and ease. And don't worry if you want to bring the magic indoors these lights are versatile enough for prolonged indoor use too. So go ahead and let your creativity shine with these versatile and reliable LED String Lights from Eagle Connect. With the ability to add more connectable lights to an existing starter cable, you can easily customize the length to fit your needs. The lights come in multiples of 5m and 10m lengths, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for any room or occasion. Whether you need a few extra meters for a specific area or want to extend your lighting throughout a larger space, our Eagle Connect system has you covered. Order the total length you require, and we will provide you with the appropriate combination of 5m and 10m lengths to get the job done. Featuring high-quality, long-life LED bulbs, our lights are not only energy efficient but also durable. Choose from Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to create a magical ambiance for any occasion. With our Eagle Connect light systems, you can easily transform any space into a beautifully illuminated environment, the possibilities are endless.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 500 LEDs across 12.5 metres of lit length provide a bright, evenly spaced display with fuller festive coverage.
- Colour mix: Blue, purple and white LEDs create a distinctive festive glow for Christmas trees, displays and seasonal decorations.
- Eight lighting effects: Combination, waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, and steady on.
- 8-hour timer function automatically switches the lights on for 8 hours and off for 16 hours.
- Mains powered with a 5-metre lead from the plug to the first light, offering flexible placement indoors or outdoors.
- Select from combination, waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, and steady-on effects.
- Built-in timer runs the lights for 8 hours, then switches them off for 16 hours.
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, provided the transformer remains indoors.
- Dark green lead cable with a 5-metre distance from the plug to the first light, giving a total length of 17.5 metres.
- Includes a 1-year warranty for added peace of mind.

## Information
Create a colourful festive display with these Samuel Alexander TreeBrights Christmas string lights. The set includes 500 blue, purple and white LEDs arranged across 12.5 metres of illuminated cable, providing bright and even coverage for Christmas trees, porches, garden shrubs and indoor decorations. Choose from eight lighting effects, including combination, waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, and steady on. The built-in timer operates for 8 hours and switches off for 16 hours, making seasonal lighting simple to manage. The lights feature a dark green cable, a 5-metre lead from the plug to the first light and a total length of 17.5 metres. Mains powered and suitable for indoor and outdoor use, with the transformer kept indoors.

Manufactured with durable rubber cables, these lights are built to withstand the elements, making them a top choice for all-season use. From sunny summer days to chilly winter nights, these LED Icicle Lights will keep your outdoor space looking bright and beautiful year-round. Transform your outdoor setting with these versatile and weather-resistant lights and illuminate any occasion with style and ease. And don't worry if you want to bring the magic indoors these lights are versatile enough for prolonged indoor use. So go ahead and let your creativity shine with these versatile and reliable LED icicle Lights from Eagle Connect. Illuminate your space with our versatile mains voltage Eagle Connect light systems. With the ability to add more connectable lights to an existing starter cable, you can easily customize the length to fit your needs. The lights come in multiples of 2m and 5m lengths, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for any room or occasion. Whether you need a few extra meters for a specific area or want to extend your lighting throughout a larger space, our Eagle Connect system has you covered. Simply order the total length you require, and we will provide you with the appropriate combination of 2m and 5m lengths to get the job done. With our Eagle Connect light systems, the possibilities are endless. Featuring high-quality, long-life LED bulbs, our lights are not energy efficient and durable. Choose from Cool White or Warm White with or without a twinkle to create a magical ambiance for any occasion. With our Eagle Connect light systems, you can easily transform any space into a beautifully illuminated environment.

## Features
- Made with durable rubber cables
- Ideal for Multiple Outdoor Uses
- Customizable Length

## Information
Manufactured with durable rubber cables, these lights are built to withstand the elements, making them a top choice for all-season use. From sunny summer days to chilly winter nights, these LED Icicle Lights will keep your outdoor space looking bright and beautiful year-round. Transform your outdoor setting with these versatile and weather-resistant lights and illuminate any occasion with style and ease. And don't worry if you want to bring the magic indoors these lights are versatile enough for prolonged indoor use. So go ahead and let your creativity shine with these versatile and reliable LED icicle Lights from Eagle Connect. Illuminate your space with our versatile mains voltage Eagle Connect light systems. With the ability to add more connectable lights to an existing starter cable, you can easily customize the length to fit your needs. The lights come in multiples of 2m and 5m lengths, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for any room or occasion. Whether you need a few extra meters for a specific area or want to extend your lighting throughout a larger space, our Eagle Connect system has you covered. Simply order the total length you require, and we will provide you with the appropriate combination of 2m and 5m lengths to get the job done. With our Eagle Connect light systems, the possibilities are endless. Featuring high-quality, long-life LED bulbs, our lights are not energy efficient and durable. Choose from Cool White or Warm White with or without a twinkle to create a magical ambiance for any occasion. With our Eagle Connect light systems, you can easily transform any space into a beautifully illuminated environment.

## Features
- Made with durable rubber cables
- Dramatic Lighting Display Featuring 250LEDs per 5m
- Versatile Indoor  Outdoor Use

## Information
With easy-to-connect plugs, you can easily customize the length of the cluster lights to suit your needs. Whether you want to create a dramatic lighting display or add a subtle glow to your outdoor space, these connectable cluster fairy lights are the perfect solution. Cluster Christmas lights are the perfect way to add a touch of magic to your holiday decor. These LED lights are clustered together on a string, creating a stunning garland of lights. Easy to install and versatile, they can be used inside or outside to create a warm and cozy ambiance. The lights are available in multiples of 5m lengths, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for any room or occasion. Whether you need a few extra meters for a specific area or want to extend your lighting throughout a larger space, our Eagle Connect system has you covered. Simply order the total length you require, and we will provide you with the appropriate number of 5m lengths to get the job done. With our Eagle Connect light systems, the possibilities are endless.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Connectable led cluster lights 5m to 100m
- Choose warm cool copper gold or rbg lights
- Durable rubber cable with waterproof end caps

## Information
Transform your home, garden, or event space with these premium LED cluster lights, designed to create a magical glow indoors or outdoors. As part of a versatile mains-powered system, they offer bright, energy-efficient, long-lasting illumination ideal for festive displays, weddings, parties, or everyday decoration. The dense cluster layout forms a vivid garland of lights, giving a striking, eye-catching effect. With simple connector plugs, multiple 5m lengths can be joined together to reach up to 100m, letting you tailor the coverage to suit your space. Choose from warm white, cool white, copper gold, or RGB colour-changing options to match any mood or occasion. Made with a durable rubber cable and waterproof connectors, these lights are designed for reliable outdoor use in all weather, while also being perfect for indoor settings. Attach them to porches, fences, gutters, and gates, or drape them over mantels, shelves, and Christmas trees for a professional finish. Easy to install and built to last, these connectable LED cluster lights offer flexibility, durability, and a timeless glow, helping you brighten small corners or create impressive large-scale displays season after season.

- Connectable led cluster lights 5m to 100m

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Connectable led cluster lights 5m to 100m
- Choose warm cool copper gold or rbg lights
- Durable rubber cable with waterproof end caps

## Information
Transform your home, garden, or event space with these premium LED cluster lights, designed to create a magical glow indoors or outdoors. As part of a versatile mains-powered system, they offer bright, energy-efficient, long-lasting illumination ideal for festive displays, weddings, parties, or everyday decoration. The dense cluster layout forms a vivid garland of lights, giving a striking, eye-catching effect. With simple connector plugs, multiple 5m lengths can be joined together to reach up to 100m, letting you tailor the coverage to suit your space. Choose from warm white, cool white, copper gold, or RGB colour-changing options to match any mood or occasion. Made with a durable rubber cable and waterproof connectors, these lights are designed for reliable outdoor use in all weather, while also being perfect for indoor settings. Attach them to porches, fences, gutters, and gates, or drape them over mantels, shelves, and Christmas trees for a professional finish. Easy to install and built to last, these connectable LED cluster lights offer flexibility, durability, and a timeless glow, helping you brighten small corners or create impressive large-scale displays season after season.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- IP65 waterproof LED string lights
- Connectable upto 100m length
- Warm and cool white energy-saving LEDs

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a white rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long-lasting and energy-efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White or Warm White to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

- Connectable led cluster lights 5m to 100m
- Choose warm cool copper gold or rbg lights

Transform your home, garden, or event space with these premium LED cluster lights, designed to create a magical glow indoors or outdoors. As part of a versatile mains-powered system, they offer bright, energy-efficient, long-lasting illumination ideal for festive displays, weddings, parties, or everyday decoration. The dense cluster layout forms a vivid garland of lights, giving a striking, eye-catching effect. With simple connector plugs, multiple 5m lengths can be joined together to reach up to 100m, letting you tailor the coverage to suit your space. Choose from warm white, cool white, copper gold, or RGB colour-changing options to match any mood or occasion. Made with a durable rubber cable and waterproof connectors, these lights are designed for reliable outdoor use in all weather, while also being perfect for indoor settings. Attach them to porches, fences, gutters, and gates, or drape them over mantels, shelves, and Christmas trees for a professional finish. Easy to install and built to last, these connectable LED cluster lights offer flexibility, durability, and a timeless glow, helping you brighten small corners or create impressive large-scale displays season after season.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Warm/Cool White LED Icicle Lights
- Black or White Rubber Cable Options
- Connectable Up to 50m Length

## Information
Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 percent twinkle. Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. Each set features long-lasting, energy-efficient LED bulbs for consistent, reliable performance. The robust rubber cable and waterproof connectors ensure durability in all weather conditions, making them suitable for year-round use. Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

## Features
- IP65 Waterproof LED String Lights
- Connectable Up To 100m Length
- Warm/Cool White Energy Saving LEDs

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a white rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White or Warm White to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features

- Durable black and white rubber cable
- Connectable up to 50m length

Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional-quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance, and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

- Black or White Rubber Cable Options

As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Information
Bring your celebrations to life with this Set of Two Tone Christmas String Lights. A stunning combination of LEDs that glow in warm white and soft multi-colours. Whether you're decking out your home for Christmas, hosting a party, or adding ambient charm year round, these lights offer both elegance and fun in one continuous display. Switch effortlessly between warm white and multi-colour modes to match the mood. Suitable for indoor use only.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 240 white LED string lights
- Green cable
- 8 lighting effects
- 8 hour on, 16 hour off timer
- Length from Plug to First Bulb: 10m
- Bulb Spacing: 7.5cm
- Total Lit Length: 18m
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
- BS IP44 transformer
- Suitable for 6ft Christmas trees

## Information
The exceptional characteristics and versatility of these White Christmas String Lights have made them one of our best-selling products. They look fantastic on mantelpieces, garlands, 6ft Xmas trees, garlands, and many more. There is a memory feature and timer built in into these Christmas lights. You may set the holiday lights to turn on for eight hours and then off for another eight hours using the timer. After that, the lights will remember when you turned them on thanks to the memory feature, and they will turn on automatically every day at that time. Because you won't need to turn them on or off at all, this is quite convenient. There are 8 light settings available (Combination, In Wave, Sequential, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash, Steady On). Please Note: The transformer must be plugged indoors only.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Warm and cool white LED icicle lights
- Black or white rubber cable options
- Connectable upto 50m length

## Information
Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 percent twinkle. Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. Each set features long-lasting, energy-efficient LED bulbs for consistent, reliable performance. The robust rubber cable and waterproof connectors ensure durability in all weather conditions, making them suitable for year-round use. Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

## Features
- Energy efficient long life led bulbs Warm Cool
- Connectable system up to 100m in 5m or 10m sets
- Flexible weatherproof cable, strong and easy install

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- 5M LED fairy lights create warm decorative lighting indoors and outdoors
- Battery operated design allows flexible placement without sockets
- Remote control with multiple lighting modes for easy customisation
- Weather-resistant construction suitable for patios and gardens
- Timer function automatically switches lights off for convenience
- Ideal for Christmas decor, bedrooms, parties, and balconies

## Information
Decorate your home, bedroom, garden or patio with the Globrite 5M LED Fairy Lights. Designed for indoor and outdoor use, these battery operated string lights add a warm decorative glow to festive displays, parties, Christmas trees, balconies and everyday room decor. The battery-powered design allows flexible placement without needing nearby sockets, making these lights ideal for hard-to-reach spaces, garlands, wreaths, wall decor and outdoor decorations. The included remote control lets you easily switch between multiple lighting modes including twinkle, flashing and steady glow settings to suit different occasions and moods. Built with weather-resistant materials, these fairy lights are suitable for seasonal outdoor displays and year-round decorative use around patios, fences and balconies. The timer function helps automate operation for added convenience while preserving battery life. Featuring 50, 100 and 200 bright LED lights across a 5 metre string, these decorative lights provide excellent coverage while remaining lightweight and easy to install. Available in Warm White, Cool White and Multi-colour options, they suit a wide range of decorative styles and occasions.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Smart Lighting Control  Use the Hello Fairy app or included remote to adjust brightness, colours and lighting modes from a distance.
- 40cm Foldable White Frame  The larger white metal sphere creates a bright, modern decorative feature and folds flat after use for convenient seasonal storage.
- Flexible Indoor and Outdoor Display  Suitable for decorating porches, patios, entrances and indoor spaces, with a 3m lead cable to give you more freedom when positioning the light. Transformer must remain indoors and dry.
- Music Sync and Automatic Timer  Create more interactive displays with sound-responsive lighting, or schedule the light to switch on and off automatically at chosen times.

## Information
Add vibrant festive colour to your home or garden with the Pegdev 40cm RGB Colour Changing Foldable Christmas Ball Light. Designed with a stylish 40cm white metal ball frame, this decorative light features micro lights positioned around the frame to create an eye-catching multicolour display that works well for Christmas decorating, parties and seasonal displays. Choose and adjust the lighting using the Hello Fairy App or the included handheld remote control, giving you an easy way to customise the colour and lighting effects to suit your setting. The white frame provides a bright, clean finish while allowing the illuminated colours to stand out clearly when switched on. Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorating, the ball can be displayed around patios, porches, entrances, covered outdoor areas and other festive spaces. For outdoor use, the transformer should always be kept indoors and dry. The clever foldable design also makes the decoration simple to set up and store. Simply open the partially assembled frame gently and secure it together to create the full 40cm spherical shape. Once Christmas is over, the ball folds flat again for compact, convenient storage until it is needed next season.

Bring a magical festive glow to your home or garden with this Set of 5 Acrylic Christmas Tree Lights from Christow. Crafted from clear acrylic and lit by 40 static white LEDs, they’re shaped like mini Christmas trees with stars on top for an enchanting festive look. Display them indoors or outdoors along windowsills, mantelpieces, or patio walls, with a battery-powered design and built-in timer for easy placement. Outdoor-Safe Battery Pack The Christmas tree lights are powered by an IP44-rated battery pack for safe indoor or outdoor use. A 50cm clear lead wire allows flexible placement, while the discreet cable blends neatly into its surroundings for a cleaner festive display. Timer Function Designed for convenience, the built-in timer allows the Christmas tree lights to switch on at the same time each evening and turn off automatically after six hours. A manual setting also gives you full control whenever needed. Space Up to 30cm Apart Each Christmas tree is connected by a 30cm cable, allowing you to position the first and last tree up to 120cm apart. Arrange them along a windowsill or mantelpiece, or group them together to create a magical festive display. ## Features
- Compact 100cm maypole tree for indoor and outdoor festive displays
- 146 LEDs across eight light strings and an illuminated star topper
- White, warm white, or multi-colour LEDs with eight modes and memory
- Battery powered with timer; requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
- Ready-assembled base and four ground stakes for secure lawn display

## Information
Bring an eye-catching festive glow to your home or garden with the Christow Battery-Powered LED Maypole Christmas Tree. Standing 100cm tall, it has eight illuminated strings arranged beneath a glowing star to create a classic tree-shaped silhouette. Choose white, warm white, or multi-colour micro LEDs to match your Christmas theme, with eight light modes adding variety to the display. Requiring no mains socket, it’s easy to position on a lawn, patio, entranceway, or inside your home. Classic Maypole Silhouette Eight strings sweep from the illuminated star topper down to the base, creating an enchanting maypole tree silhouette. Each string contains 17 micro LEDs, with 10 more inside the star. Together, the 146 micro LEDs create an eye-catching festive glow. 8 Light Modes with Memory From subtle glows to livelier effects, cycle through eight different lighting modes to set the perfect festive mood. A built-in memory function conveniently recalls your previous selection, so the tree is always ready to shine your way when it’s switched back on. Battery Powered with Built-In Timer An IP44-rated battery box powers the tree, allowing you to position it without a nearby mains socket. A 1m black lead connects the battery box to the base, while the timer switches the lights on at the same time each evening before turning them off six hours later. Quick Assembly & Outdoor Stability The base arrives ready-assembled to reduce setup time. Simply join the pole sections, then connect the light strings from the star topper to the base. Four U-shaped ground stakes help anchor the tree securely on soft ground – ideal for a lawn display. ## Features
- Compact 100cm maypole tree for indoor and outdoor festive displays
- 146 LEDs across eight light strings and an illuminated star topper
- White, warm white, or multi-colour LEDs with eight modes and memory
- Battery powered with timer; requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
- Ready-assembled base and four ground stakes for secure lawn display

## Information
Bring an eye-catching festive glow to your home or garden with the Christow Battery-Powered LED Maypole Christmas Tree. Standing 100cm tall, it has eight illuminated strings arranged beneath a glowing star to create a classic tree-shaped silhouette. Choose white, warm white, or multi-colour micro LEDs to match your Christmas theme, with eight light modes adding variety to the display. Requiring no mains socket, it’s easy to position on a lawn, patio, entranceway, or inside your home. Classic Maypole Silhouette Eight strings sweep from the illuminated star topper down to the base, creating an enchanting maypole tree silhouette. Each string contains 17 micro LEDs, with 10 more inside the star. Together, the 146 micro LEDs create an eye-catching festive glow. 8 Light Modes with Memory From subtle glows to livelier effects, cycle through eight different lighting modes to set the perfect festive mood. A built-in memory function conveniently recalls your previous selection, so the tree is always ready to shine your way when it’s switched back on. Battery Powered with Built-In Timer An IP44-rated battery box powers the tree, allowing you to position it without a nearby mains socket. A 1m black lead connects the battery box to the base, while the timer switches the lights on at the same time each evening before turning them off six hours later. Quick Assembly & Outdoor Stability The base arrives ready-assembled to reduce setup time. Simply join the pole sections, then connect the light strings from the star topper to the base. Four U-shaped ground stakes help anchor the tree securely on soft ground – ideal for a lawn display. ## Features
- LED Hanging Icicle Christmas Lights with icicle effect
- Choice of 135, 240, 360, 480, 720, 1000, or 2000 LEDs
- Available in 5 colours to suit your festive theme
- 8 light sequences with timer and memory function
- 5m cable to easily plug indoors for outdoor display

## Information
Create a magical festive display with these LED Hanging Icicle Christmas Lights from Christow. Available in a choice of lengths and colours, they feature hanging strands of sparkling LEDs to capture the look of shimmering icicles. Perfect for decorating rooflines, windows, mantels, and other indoor and outdoor spaces, with eight light settings and a built-in timer to effortlessly light up your home this Christmas. Sparkling Icicle Light Display Beautifully illuminated by strands of 5mm LEDs to capture the look of sparkling icicles and create a spectacular festive display. Although the LEDs are ultra-bright for an enchanting festive glow, they're also low power, energy efficient, and low cost to run. 8 Light Sequences with Memory Create the perfect festive mood by choosing from eight light settings, from a steady static glow to sparkling twinkles and flashing displays. A built-in memory function remembers your last setting, so the lights are always ready to shine your way. Built-In Timer Function Enjoy hassle-free festive lighting with a built-in timer function. Simply activate the timer and the lights will automatically light up at the same time each evening before switching off six hours later. You can also manually operate them whenever you choose. Mains Powered with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug for indoor sockets only. A generous 5m white cable allows flexible placement when displaying the lights outdoors, while remaining discreet against white guttering, window frames and fences. ## Features
- Artificial pine needles cones
- Timer function
- Flame-shaped bulbs for a realistic glow
- Solid wood construction
- Beautifully decorated with pine cone rings

## Information
Add a warm, cosy glow to your home this winter with our Christmas Candle Bridge Light. Designed with a traditional wooden arch and seven warm white LED candles. The candle bridge comes in a range of colours to match your dcor and create your dream display. Choose from a red, white, grey, or natural wooden candle bridge. The candle bridge contains seven candles which are coloured cream for a realistic waxy finish. We've also added flame-shaped LED bulbs which emit a warm white glow to resemble real candle flames. Create a spooky atmosphere with these Halloween Pathway Lights designed to illuminate your home and garden. This set includes eight creepy tree sprig branch stakes each fitted with 20 warm white LED bulbs that cast a spooky glow making them perfect for lining driveways or trick or treat pathways, patios or adding a spooky touch to indoor displays. Combining convenience style and reliability these Halloween Pathway Lights are an easy way to enhance your home with spooky magic. Create a dazzling display this Christmas with this Set of 3 Dewdrop Christmas Cone Trees. A stunning trio of contemporary metal decorations illuminated by sparkling white LED lights. Perfect for elevating your indoor seasonal decor, these elegant cone shaped trees combine sleek design with a magical glow.
